fixed: Typing or pasting "neighbor balance & box the gnat" or "larks balance & Rory O'More right", the way the figure list shows a box the gnat or Rory O'More with its balance, now gives that figure instead of unrecognized text. A box the gnat with its balance and no beat count gets 8 beats.

The shared figure grammar reads `<who> balance & box the gnat` (and swat the flea) with the balance set, at 8 beats when the line states no count. The ContraDB figure reader reads `<who> balance & Rory O'More <side>` with the balance set, so free-text entry and the combined reader do; The Caller's Box reader still does not.
